sections.heading: How entry works
sections.html:
Members may enter three quilts; non-members may enter one. A quilt must have three layers and be finished. Labels go on the back, lower left as you look at the quilt from behind.

Intake is Thursday 9 to 3. Pickup is Sunday after 5. The catalog lists every quilt with the maker, the quilter, and the year finished.

items.q: Can I enter a quilt I did not quilt?
items.a: Yes. Credit the longarmer or the person who hand quilted it on the entry form. Both names go in the catalog.
Miniatures under 24 inches on a side have their own category. Bed quilts may not exceed 120 inches on the long side, because of the pipe-and-drape.

sections.html: We meet {{meeting_info}} in {{city}}. Show planning starts in January. The rest of the year looks like any guild: programs, bees, and charity quilts for the children's hospital.
